an10.19:1.1: “Bhikkhus, there are these ten abodes of the noble ones in which the noble ones of the past, present, or future abide.
an10.19:1.3: “Here, a bhikkhu (1) has abandoned five factors; (2) possesses six factors; (3) has a single guard (4) and four supports; (5) has dispelled personal truths, (6) totally renounced seeking, (7) purified his intentions, (8) tranquilized bodily activity, and become (9) well liberated in mind and (10) well liberated by wisdom.
an10.19:1.4: These are the ten abodes of the noble ones in which the noble ones of the past, present, or future abide.”
